Violin + boxplot of one or more proteins

Source: R/plot_violin.R
plot_violin.Rd

Creates a violin plot with an overlaid boxplot for one or more assays across a categorical x-axis (e.g. time point), optionally filled by group. Visualizes the distribution of NPX values over time or across groups.

Usage

plot_violin(
  data,
  assay,
  x = NULL,
  group = NULL,
  assay_col = NULL,
  value_col = NULL,
  lod_col = NULL,
  show_lod = FALSE,
  show_boxplot = TRUE,
  comparisons = NULL,
  compare_groups = FALSE,
  test = "wilcox.test",
  paired = FALSE,
  subject_id = NULL,
  show_p_value = FALSE,
  show_significant = FALSE,
  show_overall = FALSE,
  p_cutoff = 0.05,
  bracket_nudge_y = NULL,
  step_increase = 0.12,
  palette = NULL,
  title = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

A data.frame in long format, or an OlinkExperiment.

assay

Name(s) of the protein/assay(s) to plot (must match values in `assay_col`). When multiple assays are supplied, the plot is faceted by assay.

x

Name of the x-axis variable (e.g. "Timepoint"). If NULL, auto-detected from common time/visit columns.

group

Optional column name for the fill color (violins split by group).

assay_col

Name of the assay column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "Assay").

value_col

Name of the NPX value column. If NULL, auto-detected (e.g. "NPX").

lod_col

Optional column name holding an LOD value; draws a dashed LOD reference line when supplied.

show_lod

Logical; if `TRUE`, auto-detects the LOD column (or `lod(oe)`) and draws a dashed LOD reference line (default `FALSE`).

show_boxplot

Logical; overlay a boxplot on the violins (default TRUE).

comparisons

A list of length-2 vectors specifying pairwise comparisons for statistical brackets. If `NULL` and `show_p_value`/`show_significant` is used, every pair of x levels (e.g. timepoints) is compared.

compare_groups

Logical; when `TRUE` and `group` is supplied, compare `group` levels within each `x` level rather than pooling across groups (default `FALSE`).

test

Statistical test: `"wilcox.test"` (default), `"t.test"`, `"anova"`, or `"kruskal.test"` (short aliases `"wilcox"`, `"t"`, and `"kruskal"` are also accepted). `"anova"` and `"kruskal.test"` compute an overall test across `x` levels.

paired

Logical; whether to perform paired statistical tests (default `FALSE`).

subject_id

Optional subject ID column name used to align paired samples.

show_p_value

Logical; annotate numeric p-values for each pairwise comparison (or the overall test when `test` is `"anova"` or `"kruskal.test"`). Requires `ggpubr` (default `FALSE`).

show_significant

Logical; annotate significance stars (*, **, ***) for each pairwise comparison. Requires `ggpubr` (default `FALSE`).

show_overall

Logical; annotate an overall p-value across `x` levels (ANOVA when `test = "t.test"` or `"anova"`, Kruskal-Wallis when `test = "wilcox.test"` or `"kruskal.test"`). Requires `ggpubr` (default `FALSE`).

p_cutoff

Significance threshold: when `show_significant = TRUE`, only comparisons with p < `p_cutoff` are drawn (default 0.05). Set to `NULL` to show every comparison.

bracket_nudge_y

Numeric vertical offset for the comparison brackets so they are raised above the data. If `NULL` (default), ~10 is used automatically.

step_increase

Fraction of the plot height between stacked brackets (default 0.12).

palette

Optional color palette for groups.

title

Plot title. If NULL, uses the assay name (or NULL when faceted).

...

Additional arguments passed to `ggplot2::geom_violin()`.

Value

A ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_violin(
  probc, assay = "IL6", x = "Timepoint", group = "Project"
)
} # }
